notes: Selfridges Home (UK), scoped to Home & Furniture. Access: direct HTTP fetch, no WAF/bot-block; robots.txt checked, no Claude-specific disallow. Checked: (1) main nav mega-menu - the only price-reduction destination sitewide is a single 'Sale' link under the 'Seasonal' nav group (/GB/en/cat/on_sale/, 5,200 results across the whole store, not Home-scoped); opened it and confirmed page <title> is 'Designer Sale' with meta description 'Enjoy seasonal reductions off your favourite brands...' - explicit 'seasonal reductions' language is a temporary promotional-campaign signal, not a permanence/outlet/clearance signal, so per the brief's Sale-vs-Clearance test this is EXCLUDED, not recorded as Clearance and not even flagged ambiguous (the copy is unambiguous about being seasonal); (2) full-text search of the homepage and Home department page HTML for 'clearance', 'outlet' (retail sense - the only 'outlet' hits found were React component internals 'OutletBoundary'/'AsyncMetadataOutlet', unrelated to retail), 'final sale', 'end of line', 'last chance', 'permanent' - none found; (3) footer nav - no Outlet/Clearance link or separate outlet subdomain; (4) robots.txt - no dedicated clearance/outlet path disallowed (only '*/on_sale-REDUCTIONS/*' and the generic Sale page itself, which is not clearance-worded); (5) site search for 'clearance'/'outlet' could not be run via HTTP because robots.txt disallows '?freetext='/'?freeText=' query URLs for every user-agent (not Claude-specific) - supporting-evidence gap only, not the basis for this conclusion. Conclusion: no genuine Clearance/Outlet-type merchandising PLP exists anywhere on selfridges.com (whole-store, let alone Home & Furniture specifically); the one reduced-price listing that does exist is a generic seasonal Sale correctly excluded per brief.
